records.summary: The IAF's separate 36-aircraft fly-away Rafale acquisition, following the earlier 126-aircraft MMRCA competition. This record excludes the Navy's 26 Rafale Marine aircraft and any later MRFA proposal.
records.dossierText: Service: Indian Air Force. Scope: 36 Rafale aircraft acquired in fly-away condition under the 23 September 2016 India-France Inter-Governmental Agreement. The 126-aircraft MMRCA RFP was an earlier competition and is not the final contracted quantity. Delivery schedule began in September 2019; first aircraft arrived in India in July 2020. The IAF acquisition is separate from the Indian Navy's 26 Rafale Marine contract signed in April 2025. See the linked milestone timeline for dated events and evidence.
records.reviewNotes: Official government and parliamentary sources establish the contract and acquisition scope. Delivery completion by April 2022 is the original scheduled completion date; this register avoids inferring each aircraft's individual handover date.

records.dossierText: Service: Indian Navy. Scope: 26 Rafale Marine aircraft, comprising 22 single-seat and four twin-seat aircraft. India and France signed the Inter-Governmental Agreement on 28 April 2025. The package includes training, simulators, associated equipment, weapons and performance-based logistics. Government reporting states that deliveries are to be completed by 2030. This record is distinct from the IAF's 36 Rafale aircraft.
